cases.description: Complete TDF 0.7.0 document exercising label.link at position 5, all 16 canonical task directive/sub-block slots (history at position 14), repeat lead days, suspended and due notes, due passive, timestamp normalization, quote equivalence, and history deduplication with ascending UTC + unsigned UTF-8 byte tie-breaking (including U+10400 > U+FFFF vs BMP U+FF21).

Deadline lead-window effective priority (due <= now + 86400s and overdue due <= now), due passive opt-out, Blocked/Someday/scoped guardrails, scoped and non-scoped label links, and newline/tab escapes in suspended and due notes.
